hypothesis: Separating open provider-symbol-side mechanisms by causal entry identity, marked economics, path excursion, and venue protection can improve portfolio research decisions without contaminating resolved performance or changing execution.
decision: Adopt cohort_live_entry_alignment_mechanism_v3 as report-only observability and retain the protected v25 runtime unchanged. Keep all four open lifecycles provisional and exclude them from closed win/loss, profit factor, and PnL conclusions. The current ETH short is a breakout-opposed fade and the SOL long is breakout-aligned; GOLD and SNDK require provider-native HIP-3 mechanism attribution rather than fabricated canonical regime labels. Build that HIP-3 attribution next, preserving its HA, EMA, pivot, order-block, side, and exit-mode identities. This revision cannot place, close, resize, route, rank, gate, restart, or promote a strategy.
falsifier: The implementation is invalidated if an open lifecycle enters resolved statistics, a lifecycle identity or marked value differs from the underlying immutable reflection, a protected position is reported unprotected or vice versa, evidence bytes change, or the report gains execution authority. The economic interpretation updates only after the currently open paths resolve with reconciled venue fills, fees, funding, slippage, and stop precedence.
limitations: All four open marks can reverse before their final venue exits.
Marked economics are not additive to the resolved strategy scorecard.
The ETH and SOL mechanism categories each contain one current open path.
HIP-3 assets do not carry canonical crypto regime classification and require provider-native attribution.
The live audit still reports provider_metric_telemetry_missing from the known pre-repair HIP-3 clock implementation.
No live process, route, order, stop, target, position, size, allocation, leverage, or exit policy changed.
